responsibility: Specializes the Arm backend for FreeBSD targets. It defines FreeBSD-specific preprocessor builtins, assembler and linker specs, endian-dependent linker emulation, default float ABI and AAPCS-Linux ABI choice, wchar_t layout, OS-specific profiling and instruction-cache-flush hooks, stack-note emission, unaligned-access policy for older FreeBSD releases, and related ELF/BSD target macros needed to generate correct binaries for FreeBSD/arm.
